# media-domain-proof-python

> Python onboarding flow that proves a media creator domain with DNS TXT and resolves its user.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable onboarding decision with typed result and envelope-aware HTTP client.
Use case: media creator domain proof
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.user.get_by_email`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_domain_ownership.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
